data.name: Yuvraj
data.gender_notes: Yuvraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yuva means young and raja means king. This name is derived from Sanskrit language and is used to describe a young and powerful king in Hindu mythology. The name evokes feelings of royalty, power, and youth. The name Yuvraj carries the meaning “Prince, Young King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Yuvraj usually hope their child will grow to embody prince, young king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and potential of youth.
data.etymology: Yuvraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prince, Young King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yuvraj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Yuvraj" reflects the rich cultural heritage of India and has been used historically to signify a young ruler or prince. It is a significant name in Hindu mythology, representing the idea of youthful power, strength, and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name "Yuvraj" holds a deeper spiritual significance. It represents the idea of being a ruler or king not only in the material world, but also in one's own mind and spirit. It encourages individuals to cultivate inner strength and leadership qualities, and to use their youthful energy and power to serve a higher purpose. data.spiritual_symbolism: Yuvraj: Crown Prince, embodiment of youth and royalty, symbolizing the potential and promise of young leadership.

vedic_reference.note: The title Yuvraj is mentioned in various Vedic scriptures, such as the Mahabharata and the Ramayana, where it is used to describe young princes and future kings.

historical_references.reference: Yuvraj is a title meaning 'young prince' in Sanskrit language, often used in Hindu contexts. It was commonly used in medieval India for princes who were the next in line to rule their father's kingdom.

Another famous Yuvraj in Hindu history is Prince Yudhishthira, the eldest of the five Pandava brothers in the Mahabharata epic. He was often referred to as Yuvraj, denoting his royal lineage and position as the future king of Hastinapur.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Yuvraj' in modern context is popularly associated with individuals holding significant power or influence, often in the areas of royalty, politics, or sports. In Bollywood movies, actors with the name Yuvraj have portrayed characters of royalty or next in line to inherit a throne. In Indian politics, Yuvraj is a common name for young politicians who are seen as the future leaders of their respective political parties. In cricket, Yuvraj Singh is a prominent figure who has led India's cricket team and is renowned for his exceptional skills as a cricketer.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Raj Yuvraj in Kolkata, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Yuvraj, which means "Prince, Young King". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
